description: HTTP API layer: middleware, all handlers, router, entry point, and integration tests. Depends on FEAT-001 (security), FEAT-002 (docusign client), FEAT-003 (jobs, audit services). Wires the full Chi router with HMAC middleware, implements all 16 endpoints, and provides a full integration test that exercises every endpoint with correctly signed requests against mock services.
steps: 1. Create internal/httpapi/middleware/recovery.go: Chi middleware. Wraps next with defer/recover. On panic: log via slog with stack trace (runtime/debug.Stack()), write 500 JSON response {"error":"internal server error"}.

2. Create internal/httpapi/middleware/logging.go: Chi middleware using chi middleware.RequestID pattern. Records start time, calls next, logs method/path/status/latency/request_id/client_id (from context) at INFO level via slog after response.

3. Create internal/httpapi/middleware/hmac.go: Chi middleware. Define contextKey type for client ID. Skip paths /api/health and /api/stats (use r.URL.Path prefix check). Read body with io.ReadAll (store copy back via io.NopCloser for handlers to re-read). Call security.VerifyRequest with both HMAC secrets from config. On error: write 401 JSON with reason, log audit event AuthFailed. On success: store clientID in context, call next.

4. Create internal/httpapi/handlers/health.go: HealthHandler struct (version string, startTime time.Time, pool *pgxpool.Pool). GET /api/health: returns {"status":"ok","version":"{version}","uptime_seconds":{n}}. GET /api/stats: calls repo.CountByStatus(), returns map of status -> count.

5. Create internal/httpapi/handlers/credentials.go: CredentialsHandler struct (dsAuth *docusign.JWTAuthClient). POST /api/validate-credentials: reads optional JSON body with {docusign_account_id, docusign_user_id} overrides (if provided); calls dsAuth.ValidateCredentials(ctx); on success returns {"valid":true,"account_id":"...","base_uri":"..."}, on error returns 400 with {"valid":false,"error":"..."}.

6. Create internal/httpapi/handlers/scan.go: ScanHandler struct (svc *jobs.JobService, repo *jobs.JobRepository, workerPool *jobs.WorkerPool, auditSvc *audit.AuditService). Implements:
   POST /api/scan/start — decode StartJobRequest, call repo.Create, call workerPool.Enqueue, log audit, return 202 {"scan_id":"...","status":"PENDING"}.
   GET /api/scan/{scan_id}/status — call repo.GetByID, return full Job JSON.
   POST /api/scan/{scan_id}/cancel — call repo.SetCancelled, return 200.
   POST /api/scan/{scan_id}/resume — call repo.UpdateStatus(PENDING), re-enqueue in workerPool, return 202.
   GET /api/scan/list — parse query params org_id, limit, offset; call repo.List; return paginated list.
   GET /api/scan/statistics — call repo.CountByStatus per org; return summary.
   DELETE /api/scan/{scan_id}/remove — call repo.Delete (only if status COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED), return 204.

7. Create internal/httpapi/handlers/normalization.go: NormalizationHandler struct (svc *jobs.JobService, repo *jobs.JobRepository). Implements:
   POST /api/normalization/{scan_id}/normalize — fetch job, re-run normalization + storage steps only (skip fetch stages), return 202.
   GET /api/normalization/{scan_id}/tables — return list of output files produced for the job (check local dir or MinIO).
   GET /api/normalization/supported-objects — return static list ["envelopes","recipients","documents","templates"].

8. Create internal/httpapi/handlers/maintenance.go: MaintenanceHandler struct (repo *jobs.JobRepository, workerPool *jobs.WorkerPool). Implements:
   POST /api/maintenance/cleanup — parse {older_than_days int, status []string} body; delete matching jobs; return {"deleted_count":n}.
   POST /api/maintenance/detect-crashed — call repo.MarkCrashed(cfg.CrashTimeoutMinutes); return {"marked_crashed":n}.

9. Create internal/httpapi/handlers/audit.go: AuditHandler struct (svc *audit.AuditService). Implements:
   GET /api/audit/logs — query params: org_id, event_type, outcome, from, to, limit, offset; call svc.QueryLogs; return paginated results.
   GET /api/audit/stats — query param: org_id; call svc.QueryStats; return counts by outcome.

10. Create internal/httpapi/routes.go: NewRouter(cfg *config.Config, ...[all handler dependencies]...) http.Handler. Creates chi.NewRouter(), applies middleware stack (recovery, logging, hmac in that order). Registers all routes exactly as specified in the spec. The HMAC middleware is applied as a group (r.Group) covering all routes except /api/health and /api/stats which are registered outside the group.

11. Create cmd/server/main.go: Calls config.LoadConfig(). Initializes slog with level from cfg.LogLevel (slog.LevelInfo default). Connects pgxpool via database.NewPool. Runs database.RunMigrations. Creates all services (audit, docusign auth, docusign client, storage, job repo, checkpoint repo, job service, worker pool, all handlers). Creates router via httpapi.NewRouter. Creates http.Server{Addr: ":PORT", Handler: router, ReadTimeout: 30s, WriteTimeout: 60s, IdleTimeout: 120s}. Starts workerPool.RecoverOnStartup. Starts server in goroutine. Listens for SIGINT/SIGTERM on signal.NotifyContext. On signal: calls workerPool.Shutdown(shutdownCtx) then httpServer.Shutdown(shutdownCtx) with 30s timeout.

12. Create scripts/sign_request_example.go: standalone main package (package main). Reads HMAC_SECRET_KEY_CORE from env, METHOD/PATH/BODY_JSON from command line args or hardcoded example. Builds canonical string, computes HMAC-SHA256, prints all four required headers (X-DS-Signature, X-DS-Timestamp, X-DS-Client-ID, X-DS-Nonce) with example values. No side effects.

13. Create tests/integration_test.go: Spins up the full router with test doubles (mock job repo, mock DocuSign server, no real DB). Tests in table-driven format:
   - GET /api/health returns 200 (no auth required).
   - POST /api/scan/start with valid coordinator HMAC returns 202.
   - POST /api/scan/start with invalid HMAC returns 401.
   - POST /api/scan/start with engineer client (read-only) returns 403.
   - GET /api/scan/{id}/status with valid HMAC returns job JSON.
   - POST /api/maintenance/detect-crashed with valid HMAC returns 200.
   - GET /api/audit/logs with valid HMAC returns 200.
   - GET /api/normalization/supported-objects returns list.
   All HMAC signatures computed inline using the same security.BuildSignature helper.
acceptance_criteria: go build ./cmd/server/ produces a runnable binary
go test ./tests/... passes all integration tests without live services
go build ./... compiles the entire project cleanly
